title: 用户研究与证据综合
scope: Choose research methods, evaluate participant independence, and distinguish observations from supported insights.
routingDescription: Choose research methods, evaluate participant independence, and distinguish observations from supported insights.
useWhen: Choose a study method and honest sample rationale

distinguishFrom.criterion: Use product requirements for delivery scope once sufficient evidence exists.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Match discovery, usability, evaluation or prevalence goals to a method that can support them.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Explain what the proposed method can and cannot conclude.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Check recruitment, segment coverage, participant independence and saturation evidence.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Do not equate a fixed small sample with statistical prevalence or guaranteed saturation.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Trace claims to observations, distinct participants and contradictory evidence.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Separate a single observation from a recurring pattern and preserve disconfirming cases.

diagnosticChecklist.when: When participants share an organization or selection channel
diagnosticChecklist.check: Check cluster dependence, selection bias and whether the intended user group is represented.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Limit generalization to the supported population.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Choose the next participant segment or discriminating research question.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Request targeted evidence rather than more interviews without a purpose.

evidenceRequirements: Research objective, recruitment and participant/organization counts
qualityChecks: No population percentages from convenience interviews
No universal participant count for saturation
Every synthesized claim links to evidence
riskRules: Participant privacy, consent and research purpose constrain what evidence may be shared

preferredSources: Original methods references appropriate to the research question
De-identified observation records, recruitment criteria and source provenance
refreshTriggers: Method-specific standards when required for a regulated study
knowledgePolicy.onMissing: Bound the conclusion and state which current source or evidence is needed.

examples.input: Eight interviews from two companies are presented as 80% of the market needing a feature.
examples.expected: Separate participant recurrence from market prevalence and account for organization clustering.
examples.reject: Treat interview percentages as a market estimate.

adaptations: Converted task execution instructions into conditional consultation checks.
Removed persona, memory claims, model selection and tool grants.
Replaced unconditional numerical targets with context-specific evidence requirements.
